QUOTE: high = ret & 0xFF80 ... mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... low = ret & ~0xFF80 (the low 7 bits) ... if low != 0: append " : " (only if buf already has text...) ... mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that the code splits into high-level (module) and low-level halves, and that strerror renders both joined by " : " when both are present.
